jobs.title: Software Engineer, Core Infrastructure - Moveworks (New Grad)
jobs.description: It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. Moveworks: Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce. Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt. Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award. In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work. By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business. Come Join Us! As a member of the core infrastructure team, you will be responsible for architecting the next generation of the Moveworks AI infrastructure. As Moveworks grows fast, the infrastructure team is tasked with designing and operating reliable and resilient foundational services as well as frameworks that allow our product to scale seamlessly and our engineering teams to build customer facing features very rapidly. We’re building a team that indexes on moving fast, solving challenging product/engineering problems and providing value to our customers. To be successful, you'll be partnering with machine learning, search, product, data, and full stack teams to identify, define and build elegant solutions. This is an opportunity to play an integral role at the fastest-growing AI startup in its space. What you’ll do : Closely work with machine learning, search, product, data, and frontend teams, understand their infrastructure needs, influence infrastructure roadmap, and lead as well as execute on various projects Build and enhance the core infrastructure and foundational functionalities such as distributed key value store, schema-less data store, authentication and authorization, event streaming, distributed configuration management and hot reloading, rate limiting and circuit breaking, system for feature flags and A/B testing, traffic capture and replay, etc. Improve observability and reliability of Moveworks systems by building and enhancing distributed logging, tracing, monitoring, and alerting infrastructure Define methodologies and metrics to measure performance of microservices and product functionalities, identify and fix bottlenecks, as well as improve overall performance and scalability of Moveworks applications Regularly deliver deadline sensitive work that is interdependent with other engineering teams Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Lambda
jobs.description: Serverless technologies are dramatically changing the business landscape for AWS customers large and small. AWS Lambda changed how the world builds software. Developers write code, and Lambda runs it: no servers to provision or patch, and no capacity to plan. Every month, Lambda runs trillions of invocations for millions of customers, from startups to the largest enterprises. It powers web backends, APIs, data pipelines, event-driven apps, and AI agents. We're looking for experienced engineers to help lead our global-scale Lambda data plane. The data plane is the set of distributed systems that receive, route, place, scale, and run every function invocation. It has to be fast, secure, and highly available at huge scale. We're also taking serverless into new areas. That includes new compute options like Lambda Managed Instances, first-class support for web applications, and richer ways to process events at scale. As a senior engineer, you'll set the technical direction for these capabilities and turn it into production systems. A successful team member will exhibit creativity, empathy, and optimism as we push the boundaries of serverless computing in the cloud. We are inspired by what has come before and motivated to create what comes next. You'll thrive in this role if you are interested in large scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems, low latency request processing, and p100 anomalies. You are capable in one or more programming languages and open to learning new ones. You include customer experience when discussing engineering alternatives and value creating APIs that make "the right thing, the easy thing." You value operational sustainability and advocate for eliminating flaky tests as soon as possible. You also think having fun goes together with tackling hard problems like supercomputing, high availability, and building loosely coupled gRPC-based microservices, all while continuing to securely and reliably handle massive traffic with millisecond latency. Key job responsibilities - Lead the architecture and design of large-scale, highly available, low-latency data plane systems that handle customer traffic across AWS Regions - Set technical direction across teams, balancing near-term delivery with long-term architecture, and influence the Lambda roadmap - Own complex, ambiguous problems end to end, from customer need to design, implementation, deployment, and operations - Drive major improvements in invoke latency, scaling speed, efficiency, security, and resilience - Help define and deliver new serverless compute experiences for web, event-driven, and instance-based workloads - Mentor engineers, lead design and code reviews, and raise the engineering bar across the organization - Lead operational excellence: set standards for observability, deployment safety, and incident response, and drive lasting fixes - Work with product managers, engineering leaders, and partner AWS teams to deliver results for customers A day in the life You might start the day leading a design review for a new scaling mechanism, spend the afternoon digging into a tail-latency problem across the invoke path, and wrap up mentoring an engineer through their first major design document. You'll work directly with customer feedback and production metrics, and your decisions will shape how Lambda evolves over the next several years. About the team AWS Lambda is part of AWS Serverless Compute. The Lambda data plane teams own the core invoke path, the worker fleet and virtualization layer, scaling and placement, event processing, and new compute models such as Lambda Managed Instances. We value ownership, operational excellence, and simplicity, and we invest in growing engineers at every level. - 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience - 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team - 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Security Lake
jobs.description: Amazon Security Lake is a fully managed security data lake service that automatically centralizes security data from AWS environments, SaaS providers, on-premises sources, and third-party products into a purpose-built data lake, normalizing it to the Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF) so customers get a single, analytics-ready view of their security posture across their entire organization. Security Lake operates across AWS commercial and GovCloud Regions and is trusted by many of the world's largest enterprises with their most sensitive data. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to serve as a technical leader for Security Lake and across the broader AWS Security Services organization. This role is unusual in its breadth: beyond owning the architecture and operational excellence of a security-critical, customer-facing data service, you will lead critical-path initiatives across our portfolio — including Amazon Security Hub and Amazon Inspector services. You will regularly be the senior engineer who lands in an unfamiliar codebase, earns the trust of another team's engineers, and converts an ambiguous business problem into a shipped, production system. If you want the reach of a platform role combined with the hands-on depth of a service team, this is that job. Key job responsibilities - Lead the design of major deliverables end-to-end — from working backwards on ambiguous requirements, through design documents and security reviews (threat models, AppSec, operational readiness), to implementation, launch, and production operation - Serve as a technical leader across AWS Security Services: embed with partner teams (Amazon Inspector, AWS Security Hub, AWS Config), deliver on their critical path to their standards and release calendars, and hand over cleanly with documentation, tests, canaries, and runbooks - Own and raise the operational bar for Security Lake: root-cause high-severity issues to resolution, harden APIs and canaries, drive down recurring alarms, and keep a security-critical service healthy and efficient - Set technical direction and simplify: promote re-use and extension over new components, pay down architectural debt, and turn one-off solutions into durable practices the whole team adopts - Drive decisions across team boundaries — when a dependency has no fix, propose the options, build consensus among stakeholders, and unblock the launch - Mentor and grow engineers through thorough (but kind) code and design reviews, onboarding of new team members, and raising the performance bar with every review A day in the life Most of your time is spent doing hands-on engineering: designing, writing, and reviewing code for distributed data-processing and control-plane systems (primarily Java and Python services with TypeScript/CDK infrastructure). In a typical week you might author a design for a new cross-service security capability and drive it through review with senior engineers from two other teams, ship code into a partner team's codebase, dig into a production alarm and turn the root cause into a fix plus a runbook, and give design feedback that changes the direction of a teammate's approach. You will share the team's on-call rotation and own customer issues to resolution — customers trust this service with their security data, and operational excellence is everyone's job, with senior engineers setting the example. The team is compact, senior-leaning, and geographically distributed, which means high autonomy, direct access to Principal Engineers and leadership across AWS Security Services, and visible ownership of everything you ship. - 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience - 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team - 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent - 5+ years of highly scalable systems experience - Knowledge of system performance, memory management, and parallel computing principles - Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, EC2 Nitro Networking
jobs.description: Do you want to shape the future of virtualized networking in one of the world's largest public clouds? The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) NX Platforms team owns the packet processing pipeline running beneath every EC2 instance — adding encryption, firewalls (security groups), routing, billing, and monitoring to every packet on every host across our worldwide fleet of 9M+ hosts in more than 30 regions. Our vision: deliver bare-metal networking performance while raising the bar on EC2's security, availability, and reliability — unlocking capabilities only possible through true Software Defined Networking (SDN). We are growing fast and looking for senior systems engineers who can deliver ultra-high performance — our goal is processing millions of packets per second on a single CPU core. This demands highly optimized data structures, low-level hardware tuning, and expertise in C/C++. If you have a passion for systems software engineering — kernel development, embedded systems, or high-performance networking — this is a unique opportunity to define the next generation of the platform powering all new EC2 instance families and VPC features for years to come. Your code ships to production across the entire EC2 fleet — powering services like AWS Lambda and every external workload running on EC2. With frequent deployments and full ownership from design through operation, your contributions have immediate, measurable impact at global scale. With an extensive network and access to Principal, Sr. Principal, and Distinguished Engineers across EC2, AWS, and Amazon, there are many stretch opportunities to grow your skills and knowledge. Ready to build the networking substrate for the world's largest cloud? Apply today. Key job responsibilities - Own the end-to-end design, scoping, implementation, and integration testing of new features that run on the EC2 Nitro System. - Design and build secure and scalable services to enable monitoring, diagnostics, and automated recovery. - Design and build next generation hardware/software validation platforms that enables efficient CI/CD. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand and define requirements, design system architectures, and implement robust and scalable solutions. - Continuously improve development processes, tools, and automation to enhance productivity and quality. - Mentor junior engineers with scoping, design, and developing scalable and maintainable code. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Ad Performance & Delivery
jobs.description: Are you ready to build advertising technology at massive scale? Amazon Advertising's Demand Side Platform (DSP) processes billions of ad impressions daily, and our pacing and optimization systems sit at the heart of it, deciding in real time how budgets are spent, how bids are priced, and how campaigns hit their goals. Join our Bid Strategies and Pacing team to build systems that optimize ad spend across large-scale distributed infrastructure. Our systems consume live delivery signals, compute price adjustments, enforce budget caps, and distribute bidding instructions to a global fleet within seconds of each auction. As a Software Development Engineer, you'll work on systems undergoing a massive scale inflection. You'll build and operate distributed services, streaming data pipelines, and real-time control systems, learning how the pieces fit together to drive campaign performance for advertisers ranging from small businesses to large enterprises. You'll have ownership over your features end-to-end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. Working alongside applied scientists, economists, product managers, and senior engineers, you'll build both the distributed infrastructure and the optimization algorithms that run on it, growing your expertise across systems engineering, real-time processing, and applied science. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement components of real-time systems that compute price signals, enforce budget caps, and distribute bidding instructions across a globally distributed fleet - Build and operate distributed services and streaming data pipelines that process tens of billions of events daily - Contribute to campaign performance optimization: pacing algorithms, budget allocation, and bid strategy enforcement - Own features end-to-end through the full software development lifecycle, from design through deployment and operations - Collaborate with applied scientists and economists to bring optimization algorithms from research to production - Participate in operational excellence: on-call rotations, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of system reliability A day in the life You'll work closely with applied scientists, economists, product managers, and senior engineers to build campaign optimization systems at scale. On any given day you might be implementing a new feature in a distributed service, writing integration tests for a streaming pipeline, pairing with a scientist to productionize an algorithm, or investigating an operational issue. You'll get exposure to control theory, distributed systems, and applied science, with mentorship and room to grow. About the team The Bidding Strategies and Pacing team is part of Amazon DSP, building the systems that pace and optimize campaign delivery.
